LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B01.source: 把人或事夸到封神的程度，也能反过来调侃一时被捧得过高的对象。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B01.zh_CN: 把人或事夸到封神的程度，也能反过来调侃一时被捧得过高的对象。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B01.en: An emphatic "greatest ever" compliment, also used ironically for something briefly put on a pedestal.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B07.source: 刚下班，照镜子都能看出一股班味。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B07.zh_CN: 刚下班，照镜子都能看出一股班味。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B07.en: Just off work, and the office exhaustion is written all over me.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B07.source: 用一种气味形容上班留下的疲惫、神情和习惯，带着打工人的自嘲。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B07.zh_CN: 用一种气味形容上班留下的疲惫、神情和习惯，带着打工人的自嘲。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B07.en: An imagined "work smell" describes the tired look, mood and habits left by a job, as workers' self-mockery.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B14.source: 包的，这件事包在我身上。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B14.zh_CN: 包的，这件事包在我身上。

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B14.source: 用简短保证表现十足把握，失败后又能改成包翻车，自信和反讽来回切换。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B14.zh_CN: 用简短保证表现十足把握，失败后又能改成包翻车，自信和反讽来回切换。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B14.en: A compact promise of certainty that can turn into a joke about guaranteed failure when things go wrong.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_B15.en: I've learned my lesson. Please go easy on me.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B15.source: 遇到压力或吃过苦头后迅速认怂，用服软的短句表达受不了了。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B15.zh_CN: 遇到压力或吃过苦头后迅速认怂，用服软的短句表达受不了了。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_B15.en: A quick surrender after pressure or a bad experience, saying one has had enough.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P02.source: 故事说到这里才发现，今天疯狂星期四，V 我 50。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P02.zh_CN: 故事说到这里才发现，今天疯狂星期四，V 我 50。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P02.en: After all that drama: it's Crazy Thursday. Send me 50 yuan.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P02.source: 先讲让人投入的故事，结尾突然转成品牌梗和讨钱，大家再比谁的铺垫更能骗人。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P02.zh_CN: 先讲让人投入的故事，结尾突然转成品牌梗和讨钱，大家再比谁的铺垫更能骗人。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P02.en: A story draws people in before abruptly turning into a KFC joke and a request for money; the setup becomes a shared writing game.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P03.source: 加班、霉运，都给我退！退！退！
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P03.zh_CN: 加班、霉运，都给我退！退！退！
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P03.en: Overtime, bad luck: back! Back! Back!

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P03.source: 把挥手跺脚的驱赶动作套到讨厌的人和事上，用重复的喊声表达拒绝。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P03.zh_CN: 把挥手跺脚的驱赶动作套到讨厌的人和事上，用重复的喊声表达拒绝。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P03.en: A repeated shout and shooing gesture used to reject an unwanted person, task or run of bad luck.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P11.source: Six! Seven! 双手跟着节奏一上一下。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P11.zh_CN: Six! Seven! 双手跟着节奏一上一下。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P11.en: Six! Seven! Hands bouncing up and down to the rhythm.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P11.source: 数字和手势主要用来接梗、同步和认同圈子，没有固定解释；追问含义也会变成笑点。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P11.zh_CN: 喊数字配手势，图的就是现场一块儿起哄对暗号，本来也没什么标准解释，谁认真追问意思反而更好笑。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P11.en: Shouting numbers with matching hand motions just to join the crowd and trade an inside signal. There's no real definition, and asking what it means only makes it funnier.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P20.source: 用开心猫报喜，用哭泣猫诉苦，再剪出今天的故事。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P20.zh_CN: 用开心猫报喜，用哭泣猫诉苦，再剪出今天的故事。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_P20.en: Happy cat for good news, crying cat for the bad. That's today's story.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P20.source: 把共享猫片段当作有固定情绪的演员，靠选角、剪辑和字幕讲自己的日常。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P20.zh_CN: 拿那几只熟面孔的猫咪当现成演员，换几行字幕就能把今天受的气或撞上的好事演出来。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_P20.en: Casting those same familiar cats as ready-made actors: swap in a few lines of captions to act out whatever went wrong or right today.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R01.source: 交易提议：我得到好处，你来承担代价。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R01.zh_CN: 交易提议：我得到好处，你来承担代价。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R01.en: Trade offer: I get the benefits. You cover the cost.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R01.source: 把隐藏的利益关系摆成一张交换表，常靠明显不公平的条件制造笑点。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R01.zh_CN: 把隐藏的利益关系摆成一张交换表，常靠明显不公平的条件制造笑点。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R01.en: An exchange laid out in plain terms, often with an obviously unfair deal as the joke.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R02.source: 这样会更好吧？……会更好吧？
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R02.zh_CN: 这样会更好吧？……会更好吧？
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R02.en: It's going to be better, right? ...Right?

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R02.source: 对方的沉默让乐观的确认变成不安，揭出一个计划没有说出口的后果。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R02.zh_CN: 对方的沉默让乐观的确认变成不安，揭出一个计划没有说出口的后果。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R02.en: Silence turns a hopeful question into alarm, exposing an unspoken consequence of the plan.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R03.source: 刚开始是这样，现在已经变成这样。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R03.zh_CN: 刚开始是这样，现在已经变成这样。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R03.en: How it started. How it's going.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R03.source: 把同一对象的过去和现在并排，用反差讲变化，可以庆祝成长，也可以感叹崩坏。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R03.zh_CN: 把同一对象的过去和现在并排，用反差讲变化，可以庆祝成长，也可以感叹崩坏。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R03.en: Past and present shown side by side, celebrating progress or pointing out how far things have fallen.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R06.source: 大家都加码，最后谁也没比以前轻松。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R06.zh_CN: 大家都加码，最后谁也没比以前轻松。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R06.en: Everyone raises the stakes. Nobody gets any relief.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R06.source: 投入不断增加，整体回报却没跟着变多，用来抱怨教育和工作里消耗人的竞争。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R06.zh_CN: 投入不断增加，整体回报却没跟着变多，用来抱怨教育和工作里消耗人的竞争。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R06.en: Rising effort without a rise in overall rewards, often used to describe exhausting competition at school or work.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R07.source: 一起吃饭就做饭搭子，一起学习就做学习搭子。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R07.zh_CN: 一起吃饭就做饭搭子，一起学习就做学习搭子。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_R07.en: A lunch buddy for lunch, a study buddy for studying.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R07.source: 按某项活动建立轻量关系，先约好一起做什么，不必同时承担亲密朋友的全部期待。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R07.zh_CN: 干什么事就单约什么人，先把边界划在明面上，不用一上来就背上熟人交情的负担。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_R07.en: Pairing up for one specific activity with clear boundaries upfront, skipping the full weight of a close friendship.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S01.source: 房间已经着火，狗还端着杯子说：一切都好。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S01.zh_CN: 房间已经着火，狗还端着杯子说：一切都好。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S01.en: The room is on fire. The dog holds his cup and says, "This is fine."

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S01.source: 在事情失控时装作若无其事，既能自嘲，也能讽刺对危险视而不见。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S01.zh_CN: 在事情失控时装作若无其事，既能自嘲，也能讽刺对危险视而不见。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S01.en: Acting calm while things fall apart, as self-mockery or criticism of someone ignoring danger.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S03.source: 我看不懂，但我大受震撼。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S03.zh_CN: 我看不懂，但我大受震撼。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S03.en: I don't understand it, but I am deeply impressed.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S03.source: 承认自己没弄懂，却先给出强烈反应；可以是真心赞叹，也可以是在说太离谱。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S03.zh_CN: 承认自己没弄懂，却先给出强烈反应；可以是真心赞叹，也可以是在说太离谱。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S03.en: A strong reaction despite not understanding: sincere amazement, or disbelief at something absurd.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S04.en: I'm sitting this round of the rat race out.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S04.source: 面对高压和不确定的回报，选择少投入、低参与，用来自嘲或拒绝无止境的竞争。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S04.zh_CN: 面对高压和不确定的回报，选择少投入、低参与，用来自嘲或拒绝无止境的竞争。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S04.en: Putting less effort into competition with uncertain rewards, as self-mockery or a refusal to keep chasing targets.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_S05.en: Shuan Q. Thanks a lot for that.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S05.source: 用变形的 thank you 表达无语和烦躁，表面道谢，实际是在抱怨。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S05.zh_CN: 用变形的 thank you 表达无语和烦躁，表面道谢，实际是在抱怨。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S05.en: A distorted "thank you" used to sound exasperated: gratitude on the surface, a complaint underneath.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S16.source: 把眼前内容封为最高水准，可以是真心叫好，也可以故意把粗糙片段捧得过高。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S16.zh_CN: 把眼前内容封为最高水准，可以是真心叫好，也可以故意把粗糙片段捧得过高。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_S16.en: Calling something the best there is, sincerely or as an exaggerated tribute to a ridiculous clip.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W07.source: 漂亮收场，气场加分；当众出糗，气场扣分。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W07.zh_CN: 漂亮收场，气场加分；当众出糗，气场扣分。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W07.en: Smooth exit: aura gained. Public embarrassment: aura lost.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W07.source: 用看不见的 Aura 分数评价帅气和尴尬，把日常社交变成大家都能接着打分的游戏。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W07.zh_CN: 给帅气救场加分、给当众出丑扣分，拿一套根本不存在的气场分把日常小事变成大型评委席。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W07.en: Handing out imaginary aura points for smooth recoveries and docking them for public blunders, turning everyday moments into an open judging panel.

LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W10.source: 音乐一放，今天的街道就是我的电影片场。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W10.zh_CN: 音乐一放，今天的街道就是我的电影片场。
LOC_PRESET_EXPRESSION_CASE_W10.en: Cue the music. This street is my movie set today.

LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W10.source: 把自己当作生活故事的主角，可以鼓励主动生活，也可以用来嘲讽只顾自己的戏太多。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W10.zh_CN: 把自己当作生活故事的主角，可以鼓励主动生活，也可以用来嘲讽只顾自己的戏太多。
LOC_PRESET_MEANING_CASE_W10.en: Treating daily life as one's own film can encourage confidence or invite mockery for being self-absorbed.
